body: Technically all this does is choose a quality based on frame duration, which we always set to 1, and as such is always realtime. (In same timebase as pts, which we use as a frame counter...) Also no deadline for decoder. (documentation tells us it's ignored) fixes #2770 - - - This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/TokTok/c-toxcore/2898)

comment_data.body: @zoff99 should we just remove this line + the todo?
dont remove it, use VPX_DL_REALTIME for encoding
it should be properly tested though
also don't use `0` on vpx_codec_decode i think that was not optimal. but again these things need proper real world testing.

> dont remove it, use VPX_DL_REALTIME for encoding

That is the intent, instead of the intermediary const var, we just pass it to the encode function the line below (and delete the TODO).

> also don't use `0` on vpx_codec_decode i think that was not optimal. but again these things need proper real world testing.

https://github.com/webmproject/libvpx/blob/d18c34c54a1b05797d245367ee5ac05a85cf1ccc/vpx/vpx_decoder.h#L206-L209
I have been shipping tomato and tested tomato with these changes for months now, without issues.
testing with only 1 client and only on desktop. that's not proper testing and has bitten us in the backside before.
You should try the encode change with your clients then. :)

Looking at the code again, current behavior will always result in the codec deciding for realtime anyway:

- we pass a duration of `1` (in timebase? is that milli or micro?)
- we pass a deadline based on ~40fps
- encode function decides to use realtime because `duration < deadline`

https://github.com/webmproject/libvpx/blob/d18c34c54a1b05797d245367ee5ac05a85cf1ccc/vp8/vp8_cx_iface.c#L829

vp8 also only knows `GOODQUALITY` and `REALTIME` in single pass mode ...

commit.message:
chore(toxav): use realtime deadline for vp8 encoder
Technically all this does is choose a quality based on frame
duration, which we always set to 1, and as such is always realtime.
(In same timebase as pts, which we use as a frame counter...)

Also no deadline for decoder. (documentation tells us its ignored)
